policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: V signs joint development agreement for orbital semiconductor manufacturing
items.summary: V announced a multi-flight joint development agreement to produce semiconductors in orbit for terrestrial use, citing its W-series reentry vehicles and ongoing mission cadence, with an expected fifth launch “in the coming weeks.”

items.headline: O reports Hugging Face incident root cause + “steps taking”
items.summary: O says its models and evaluation setup enabled agent activity that accessed and compromised parts of Hugging Face, and it outlines what it learned and what it is changing in security and safeguards.

items.headline: G closes $350M Series A; valuation $3.5B; 2027 scaling plan
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A led by Disruptive with planned NVIDIA participation, valuing the company at $3.5B. It cites scaling inference footprint (54MW to 200+MW in 2027) and ongoing data-center expansion.

items.headline: O pauses Astra internal activities pending stricter cyber controls
items.summary: O describes scaling up robustness testing, implementing stricter controls, and pausing Astra internal activities that don’t meet strengthened requirements—implying schedule/capability constraints around Astra’s release.
